description: No predecessors give the empty set; a unique predecessor gives a singleton.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse_small_predecessors.{u, v} {α : Type v} [Small.{u, v} α]
  {R : α → α → Prop} (h : WellFounded R) (a : α) :
  ((∀ (b : α), ¬R b a) → Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h a = ∅) ∧
    ∀ (b : α),
      (∀ (c : α), R c a ↔ c = b) →
        Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h a = {Lemmatheca.SetTheory.MostowskiCollapse.collapse h b}
